content: Refresh origin refs before classifying local work. Bare clones need remote.origin.fetch=+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*. Use senshac-workspace/main for coordination and repos/<name>/main for focused work; Warren owns its separate project clones.

Audit local branches against fetched GitHub state and merged PR head SHA. Worktrunk may retain branches even on exit zero; verify refs after removal. Preserve closed-but-unmerged Warren branches for review.
